text: 你设法让那人冷静下来，告诉他至少可以有片刻时间解释发生了什么。他深吸了几口气，终于坦白道：“听着，我不知道这到底是怎么回事。约书亚叫我们来这里，可没说过会这样！不管发生了什么，都不是自然现象！情况开始失控后，我就拿上能找到的看起来最值钱的东西，跑了。”他指了指自己搬着的那座镶嵌宝石的祭坛。
你弯腰查看，发现侧面潦草地刻着一些字。文字极其奇怪陌生，不过你可以试着翻译。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 216
text: You manage to calm the man, assuring him that he has at least a moment to explain what’s going on. He takes a couple of deep breaths before coming clean. “Look, I don’t know what the hell is happening. Joshua called us out here but he didn’t say anything about this! Whatever’s going on, it isn’t natural! Once things started going south, I grabbed the most valuable-looking things I could find, and I ran.” He gestures down to the gemstone-studded altar he’s lugging around.
You stoop down to inspect it, and notice letters scrawled across the side. The writing is incredibly strange and unfamiliar but you can attempt to translate it.
